benford).mean()\n    ones = (g.ld==1).mean()\n    rows.append((sid,n,chi2,mad,ones))\nben = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['id','n','chi2','mad','p1']).sort_values('chi2',ascending=False)\nprint('=== Benford top 15 (chi2, crit .05 df8 = 15.5) ===')\nprint(ben.head(15).to_string(index=False))\nprint('invoice-count distribution among sellers:', inv.groupby('seller_id').size().describe())\n\n# --- (b) buyer-only companies ---\nsellers = set(inv.seller_id)\nbuyers = set(inv.buyer_id) & ids\nbuyer_only = buyers - sellers\nprint('\\nbuyer-only registered companies:', len(buyer_only))\nbo = c.loc[sorted(buyer_only)].copy()\nspend = inv.groupby('buyer_id').gross_amount.sum()\nninv = inv.groupby('buyer_id').size()\nbo['spend'] = spend.reindex(bo.index).fillna(0)\nbo['n_purch'] = ninv.reindex(bo.index).fillna(0)\nbo['spend_ratio'] = bo.spend / bo.declared_revenue_annual\nprint(bo.sort_values('spend_ratio',ascending=False).head(15).to_string())\nprint('\\ncompanies never appearing at all:', len(ids - sellers - buyers))\nEOF\n","description":"Score Benford deviation and buyer-only anomalies"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1620,"cache_read_input_tokens":20933,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1620,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"704a87ce-365c-4d0d-a4ba-72ca95833b66","uuid":"0d3867dc-e5b2-4f5b-b61d-ba2be9c8d0f5","request_id":"req_011CcsAC2QqcNtRveSaXS3Fi"}
